newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: NWE oil products fall, fuel oil drops $3.
newsitem.headline: NWE oil products fall, fuel oil drops $3.

text.p: NWE oil products softened on Thursday as the IPE pushed downwards and early fuel oil offers came in low, dealers said.
Heating oil barges dipped by around $1 as IPE March futures fell. Premiums were little changed with sellers seeking IPE March +75 cents/+$1, and buyers not willing to pay any higher than -50 cents.
High sulphur fuel oil barges fell by $3 as low offers emerged. Two barges traded, one for prompt delivery at $87 fob ARA, the other for second half March delivery at $86.
